info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Channel Specific Contact Center Management-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Contact Center Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage contact center operations tailored to individual banking channels. This API allows for the creation and configuration of specific contact center resources that optimize customer interactions across various banking platforms. Typical users include customer service managers and IT administrators who seek to enhance customer support processes. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their contact center functionalities, ensuring a more responsive and personalized service experience.

post.summary: Create a contact center management configuration.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new configuration for managing contact centers specific to a particular channel. It includes details necessary for setting up the contact center operations within the specified channel context.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to manage contact center operations specific to a channel. It should include all relevant parameters and information as indicated in the schema.
